lessons.title: Virtual Threads
lessons.html:
Project Loom - Virtual Threads

Millions of threads with minimal memory! Virtual threads make concurrency simple.

Traditional vs Virtual:

// Platform Thread (Heavy - 2MB stack)
Thread t = new Thread(() -> {
    System.out.println("Heavy thread");
});
t.start();

// Virtual Thread (Lightweight)
Thread vThread = Thread.ofVirtual().start(() -> {
    System.out.println("Lightweight!");
});

Structured Concurrency:

try (var scope = StructuredTaskScope.ShutdownOnFailure()) {
    Future<Integer> result1 = scope.fork(() -> compute(1));
    Future<Integer> result2 = scope.fork(() -> compute(2));
    scope.join();
    scope.throwIfFailed();
}

lessons.title: Pattern Matching
lessons.html:
Pattern Matching Revolution

Eliminates boilerplate instanceof + casting everywhere.

Switch Expressions:

String result = switch (obj) {
    case Integer i -> "int " + i;
    case String s when s.length() > 5 -> "long string";
    case null -> "null";
    default -> "unknown";
};

Pattern Matching instanceof:

if (obj instanceof String s && s.length() > 0) {
    System.out.println(s.toUpperCase());
}

lessons.title: Records & Sealed Classes
lessons.html:
Modern Data Classes

Records = immutable data carriers. Sealed classes = controlled inheritance.

Records:

public record User(String name, String email, int age) {}

// Auto-generates: equals(), hashCode(), toString(), accessors
User user = new User("Alice", "alice@ex.com", 30);
System.out.println(user.name());  // Alice

Sealed Classes:

public sealed interface Shape permits Circle, Rectangle {
}
public final class Circle implements Shape {
    public double radius;
}

lessons.title: Reactive Streams
lessons.html:
Reactive Programming with Java

Non-blocking, backpressure-aware data streams.

Reactive Streams:

Flux<String> names = Flux.just("Alice", "Bob", "Charlie")
    .delayElements(Duration.ofMillis(500))
    .map(String::toUpperCase);

names.subscribe(System.out::println);

lessons.title: CompletableFuture Advanced
lessons.html:
Asynchronous Programming

Compose async operations elegantly.

Composing Futures:

CompletableFuture<String> future = CompletableFuture
    .supplyAsync(() -> fetchUser(1))
    .thenApplyAsync(user -> fetchPosts(user.id))
    .thenApply(posts -> formatPosts(posts))
    .exceptionally(throwable -> "Error: " + throwable.getMessage());
